exercise: 5 materially different compositions from identical content (headline, body text, measurement value). Tested centered, asymmetric left-heavy, newspaper-column, measurement-first, and margin-led layouts.
failure_found: Composition C rated weakest by blind multimodal review — two-column split on a single short paragraph broke reading flow, forced erratic eye movement, and weakened visual hierarchy.
cause: Column-splitting was applied as a visual device without considering content length. The paragraph (~40 words) is too short for multi-column layout — the reader must jump between columns mid-thought instead of completing a continuous scan.
repair: Removed column-split. Reverted to single-column full-width text. Added meta-row beneath for secondary data (transparency, instrument, window), grouped by proximity instead of split by columns.
repair_verified: Independent A/B review confirmed Interface B (single-column) as superior — 'fix reading flow, eyes scan top to bottom.'

transfer.content: Museum exhibit label — a 3-sentence artifact description with specifications
transfer.lesson: Splitting short prose into columns forces the reader to jump between visual columns mid-paragraph. For content under ~80 words, proximity grouping (single column with inline data groupings) produces clearer hierarchy than forced multi-column layout.
transfer.verified: Independent A/B review confirmed single-column exhibit label as easier to read — 'remove eye jump, fix flow.'

model_performance: Accurate diagnosis. Identified column-split as the specific weakness. Recommended the correct repair. Transfer evaluation also confirmed.

maturity_change.note: One lab does not establish professional composition skill, but the ability to produce structurally different layouts, receive blind critique, repair a causal weakness, and transfer the lesson is evidence of stages 3-4.

lesson_retained: Column-splitting short content (under ~80 words) disrupts eye path and weakens hierarchy. Proximity grouping within a single column is superior for short-form content. The device (columns) must serve the content length, not the other way around.
limitations: Single reviewer (ag/gemini-2.5-flash) — no human validation of the hierarchy ranking
Only tested one content length and genre (scientific observation + museum label)
5 compositions is a small sample for generalization
